narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Fixed. All 625 tests pass.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39-43](src/pricing.js:39) taxed the original `cents` instead of the discounted amount, despite its own comment saying tax belongs on what the customer pays. Changed `tax` to use `discounted * taxRate`.

Nothing else was broken. No further action needed.
